ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT($Permission.SW_Bypass_Validation_Rules), ISCHANGED(StageName), ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Closed Won"), OR( ISBLANK(SW_Operations_Contact__c), ISBLANK(SW_PO_Number__c), ISBLANK(TEXT( Agreement_Type__c )), AND( ISPICKVAL(Estimating_Tool__c, "Procore"), ISBLANK(SW_Procore_Id__c) ) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Operations Contact, PO Number and Agreement Type are required before moving to Closed Won. And Procore Id is required if Estimating Tool is Procore.
